beats.text: Start by identifying the consequence attached to a judge's output.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Read the chapters on norms and rubrics before choosing an evaluation model.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Then follow the procedure, measurement, and security chapters as one connected design problem.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The later institutional discussion asks whether the resulting authority can be challenged in practice.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Judgment Engines is worth reading when evaluation quietly begins to govern real decisions.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It helps distinguish a useful assistant to judgment from an unchecked source of institutional power.
